categories.main_business_segments: Zhongjin Gold Corp., Ltd. primarily operates in gold and non-ferrous metal mining, beneficiation, and smelting. Its core business segments include mining operations and smelting operations, producing gold, copper, silver, and sulfuric acid products. The company also engages in geological exploration, processing and sales of by-products, and related technical research and consulting services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced mining and smelting technologies, including proprietary pyrometallurgical arsenic removal techniques and high-purity gold production technologies. It emphasizes digital and green transformation, promoting intelligent mine construction and process optimization. The company also leverages a comprehensive technology innovation system supported by a national-level gold research institute and design institute.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Zhongjin Gold serves primarily industrial customers in the precious metals and non-ferrous metals sectors, including gold and copper product buyers. Its sales channels include the Shanghai Gold Exchange and other commodity trading platforms. The company’s products are sold mainly within China, with a significant portion of sales to affiliated entities under the China National Gold Group.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with mining and smelting facilities distributed across key mineral-rich regions such as Inner Mongolia, Shaanxi, Henan, Liaoning, Hebei, and others. It holds mining rights covering approximately 637 square kilometers and maintains resource reserves primarily within these domestic regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhongjin Gold operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the gold and copper supply chain, including resource exploration, mining, beneficiation, and smelting. It also engages in downstream activities such as product processing, wholesale, and export-import trade, integrating vertically within the precious metals industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on high-quality development through resource acquisition, technological innovation, and operational efficiency. It prioritizes digitalization, green mining, and intelligent mine construction. R&D efforts focus on advanced smelting technologies, environmental protection, and product quality improvement, supported by significant investment in research and development and patent acquisition.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of gold, copper, and related metal products. Sales are conducted via commodity exchanges and direct contracts, with pricing often linked to market prices on exchanges such as the Shanghai Gold Exchange. The company also earns income from by-product processing and related technical services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhongjin Gold is a leading state-owned enterprise in China's gold mining industry, controlled by China National Gold Group. It holds a strong market position with significant resource reserves and production capacity. Its main competitors include other large domestic gold producers and smelting companies, but Zhongjin Gold benefits from state backing and integrated resource and technology advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Zhongjin Gold reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 61.26 billion, a 7.2% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.98 billion, up 57.11%. Total assets stood at RMB 52.68 billion with a net asset value of RMB 25.91 billion. The company demonstrated steady growth in profitability, operational efficiency, and cash flow generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its resource advantages with high-quality mineral reserves, advanced proprietary technologies, and strong talent and innovation capabilities. It differentiates itself through integrated mining and smelting operations, certified product quality (LBMA certification), and commitment to sustainable and green mining practices. Its close collaboration with China National Gold Group provides robust support in resource acquisition, technology, and market access.
